# Acme 小店退货政策 / Acme Store Return Policy

## 退货政策

自签收之日起 30 天内，未使用且包装完好的商品可以申请无理由退货。
退货运费由买家承担；如商品存在质量问题，运费由 Acme 小店承担。
退款将在收到退货后 5 个工作日内原路退回。

## Return policy

Unused items in their original packaging can be returned within 30 days of delivery.
Customers pay return shipping unless the item is defective, in which case Acme pays.
Refunds are issued to the original payment method within 5 business days after we receive the return.

## 不可退货商品 / Non-returnable items

定制商品、礼品卡和已拆封的耳机不支持退货。
Custom-made items, gift cards and opened earphones cannot be returned.
